verdict: The experiment requires sigma_m = 9-41 MPa. Real Fe-Al magnetostriction supplies 1.1-8.0 MPa. The manuscript's 147 MPa overshoots the requirement by 3.6-17x and, fed forward, predicts enhancements of order 1e6-1e31 instead of 25%. Two independent routes therefore place the true interface stress at a few to a few tens of MPa.
